newsitem.title: LEBANON: Hizbollah threatens suicide bombings in Israel.
newsitem.headline: Hizbollah threatens suicide bombings in Israel.

text.p: Lebanon's pro-Iranian Hizbollah vowed on Tuesday to carry out suicide bomb attacks against Israeli targets in Israel a day after Israeli troops killed five of its guerrillas in south Lebanon.

"Israel will witness explosions and suicide bombings inside all of its posts...inside occupied land," Hizbollah deputy secretary-general Naee'm Kassem told a crowd of thousands at a funeral procession of four fighters in the south Lebanon town of Nabatiyeh.
"We say to Israel 'no peace in the region with your presence of occupation'," the white-turbaned sheikh added.
Peace talks between Israel and both Lebanon and Syria are stalled over Israel's refusal to withdraw from the Syrian Golan Heights and from Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone.

Israel captured the Golan Heights from Syria in the 1967 Middle East War. It carved out the south Lebanon buffer zone in 1985 to shield its northern borders from guerrilla attacks after it withdrew the bulk of its 1982 invasion troops from Lebanon.
On Monday, Israeli commandos in helicopters backed by warplanes raided suspected Hizbollah targets in southern Lebanon, triggering fierce clashes at Kfour in Nabatiyeh.
Five Hizbollah guerrillas were killed later by three roadside bombs planted by the Israeli commandos.
